ISS seeks to BE a place of belonging and CREATE places where every person is welcomed, embraced, and valued for exactly who they are. Places where people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves.

As a global leader in facilities services we connect people and places to make the world work better. Whether directly or indirectly, you’ll play a vital role in supporting our placemakers in delivering exceptional workplace experiences for our customers. Together, we make space for people and businesses to thrive.

Location: Copenhagen, DK

Language: English

Main purpose of the position:

As Sales Operations Specialist, you will be driving the implementation and anchoring of the global initiatives in our core sales function and will transform our global commercial approach into world class, standardized, focused and proactive. You will also support countries deploying the tools, processes and platforms to drive an efficient sales execution strategy.

What you’ll do:

• Anchor ‘ISS Way of Selling’, a standardized global set of sales processes that provides an efficient commercial ecosystem and frames the sales execution process

• Drive adoption of the ISS Sales Process, enabling transparent, data-driven, and proactive interactions between our sales teams and our customers, enforcing a customer driven approach

• Support the Commercial Capabilities Development processes going across onboarding, competencies development and Commercial Academy

• Implement and drive the continuous improvement of the already launched tools, systems and processes required to build effective sales teams in countries and globally

• Drive continuous adoption, usage, and development of our CRM platform in close coordination with the sales & commercial managers to drive viability and insights derived from our CRM platform and to enable enhanced sales performance

• Constantly scanning the ISS global commercial team for best-in-class tools, recommend standardization and adoption through bringing the best of ISS to be shared across the global organization

Who you’ll work with:

• Global and countries commercial team (across all roles)

Key qualifications:

• Solid sales experience - has held positions within sales, account management and/or sales operations in a global B2B environment (3+ years)

• Proven track record of driving improvement projects and initiatives beyond scope of initial role

• Experience in working within matrix organizations, with high cross functional collaboration abilities

• Project management capabilities, able to orchestrate the timely delivery of outcomes – possibly for different projects simultaneously

• Be analytical and structured.

Personal skills you excel:

• Be an excellent communicator, able to engage stakeholders at different levels and with different cultures

• Ability to maintain professionalism always under stressful situations

Why ISS

At ISS, we are more than just a service provider of cleaning, food, workplace and technical services, we are a partner in our customers’ success. By creating exceptional service moments and transforming workplaces into spaces where employees feel valued, engaged and productive, we enhance productivity and help our customers to attract talent and grow their businesses. This begins with our own people through training, career development, and a supportive culture – empowering them to deliver outstanding service. We know that when our people thrive, they create spaces where our customers’ employees and businesses thrive too.

ISS is a Place to Be You.

Be who you are. Become what you want. Be part of something bigger.

Become more. Become ISS.

How You’ll Apply

Apply directly via the link on this page by submitting a cover letter, CV and other relevant documents for the position you are applying for.

We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible.

Phanofi is a DTU spin-out building the next generation of optical communication infrastructure. We design integrated photonic interconnect chips that dramatically reduce power consumption and increase data throughput for AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space applications. As a diverse team of 15 people, we are at an exciting inflection point, and we are looking for a senior leader to drive our commercial growth.

As Head of Business Development, you will own Phanofi's commercial trajectory. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will define and execute the go-to-market strategy, forge high-value industry partnerships, lead the company's funding and grant initiatives, and represent Phanofi on the global stage. This is a senior, highly visible role with the opportunity, and expectation, to build the business development function from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Strategy & Commercial Leadership: Define and execute Phanofi’s business development strategy, establish commercial goals and KPIs, and drive market expansion across AI datacenters, quantum computing, and space sectors.

• Industry Relationships & Partnerships: Build and maintain strategic relationships with key stakeholders across the data communications, semiconductor, and photonics industries, while leading partnership discussions and negotiations.

• Market Intelligence & Business Insights: Conduct market research, monitor industry trends and competitive developments, and translate technical innovations into compelling business opportunities and commercial strategies.

• Brand Representation & External Communications: Represent Phanofi at industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events, while supporting thought leadership, public relations, and external communications activities.

**What We Are Looking For

**

• Experience: You bring a minimum of 5 years of experience in business development, or commercial leadership within the photonics, semiconductor, deep-tech, or related technology industries. You have a proven track record of securing strategic partnerships, commercial agreements, or major funding opportunities.

• Technical Background: You have a strong engineering or scientific background, preferably in photonics, integrated optics, electronics, communications, or a related field, enabling you to engage confidently with technical teams and customers.

• Education: A master’s degree in Engineering, Physics, or a related discipline is preferred. An MBA combined with a technical degree is considered an advantage.

• Skills: You possess strong business development, partnership management, negotiation, and market analysis skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into compelling business value propositions.

• Leadership & Soft Skills: You are a strategic and entrepreneurial leader who can influence cross-functional teams, communicate effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders, and thrive in a fast-paced deep-tech startup environment. Fluency in English is required; Danish or other European languages are considered a plus.

**The Perks

**We care about your long-term growth and well-being. We offer performance-based stock options, healthcare insurance, professional development support, and a positive culture with free snacks. You will also enjoy standard Danish benefits, including 5 weeks of paid holiday and maternity/paternity leave.

**How To Apply

**If you are interested in joining us on our entrepreneurial journey, we encourage you to submit your CV and a cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you!

Phanofi is committed to providing a workplace where equal opportunity and non-discrimination are fundamental principles. In accordance with Danish law and the European Union’s legal framework, Phanofi ensures that all employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, pay, promotion, training, and termination, are made without regard to gender, race, color, religion or belief, political affiliation, sexual orientation, age, disability, or national, social, or ethnic origin.

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. • Implementing cloud-agnostic infrastructure abstractions to help Databricks engineers more efficiently manage and operate their services.

• Develop tools and processes that drive engineering efficiency at Databricks. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Do you want to turn innovative ideas into medical devices that make a difference? If you have a flair for mechanical design, enjoy taking ownership and solving complex challenges, we would love to hear from you.

In this position, you will likely thrive the most if you naturally tend to take charge and support your colleagues. You may be a strong mechanical designer in your field, but you should also identify yourself with the values of Taking Charge and Team Up. If you have experience in driving technical development, that will certainly help you succeed in this role.

The role is based at **our Innovation Site in Ballerup, Denmark.

**

Key responsibilities

In this role, you will be in a key position in the development of Ambu’s future products. You can therefore expect to:

• Identify user needs, design inputs and specifications through participation in the project start-up phase where interaction with key opinion leaders, doctors and other experts worldwide is crucial to fulfil the ambitious innovation targets

• Be a key influencer in significant development projects within Ambu

• Successfully completed a technical or scientific course of study, e.g., mechanical or medical engineering resulting in a broad technical understanding

• Good strong knowledge of working with a CAD system e.g. Inventor, Solidworks, Creo, Catia

• Have some experience in product development and/or design of safety-critical products

• Experience working with the development of Medical Devices is considered an advantage, however other highly regulated industries could also be relevant

• Relevant experience in the design of mechanical and plastic components for high volumes from the fields of injection molding, extrusion, and tool design

• Professional level of both written and spoken English

Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social, and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

Do you want to grow with Ambu?

The team is expanding and would love to hear from you!  If this role sparks your interest, go ahead and apply today.

The National Center of Excellence PREDICT at Aalborg University in Copenhagen is looking to recruit a motivated and dedicated biostatistician with an interest in the technical part of research to join our international and interdisciplinary group of researchers in a double role as biostatistician and technical contact person. The position is for 3 years, full-time (37 hours per week) and is open for appointment from March 1st 2027.

Your work tasks

As biostatistician in PREDICT you will be involved in epidemiological studies of risk factors for IBD, pre-clinical disease development and treatment of IBD. You will join an active group of dedicated biostatisticians and data scientists ensuring knowledge sharing and continuous professional development.

You will contribute to study planning, take responsibility for data management and statistical analyses of nationwide register data and large datasets collected in PREDICT, and contribute to the interpretation and reporting of the results, including co-authoring of scientific papers.

In addition to the biostatistical task, the position also includes the role of the primary technical contact person on our data infrastructure hosted on the National Genom Center’s HPC system. You will coordinate technical support, manage user access and onboarding, and assist researchers with data management, troubleshooting, and computational workflows. The role also involves ensuring secure handling of research data and contributing to the development and optimization of technical workflows.

Your competencies

Ideally, you have the following qualifications:

•    A master’s degree in statistics or equivalent

•    Experience conducting statistical analyses in epidemiological research

•    Knowledge about time-to-event analysis and related statistical methods.

•    Strong programming skills in R and/or Python

•    Experience in working with Linux-based computing environments

•    Experience working on High Performance Computing (HPC) systems

•    Experience with shell scripting for workflow automation and troubleshooting

•    Strong problem-solving skills and ability to support colleagues with technical challenges

•    Excellent communication and collaboration skills

Note that you must be qualified for both parts of the position to be taken into consideration.

Who we are

PREDICT was founded in 2021 and is at the forefront of international research to unravel the cause and prognosis of inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD), which are chronic and disabling conditions affecting millions of people worldwide. The Center is composed of biologists, clinicians, epidemiologists, and data scientists working with collaborators nationally and internationally to push the boundaries of precision medicine research and create real-world impact in IBD. We have state-of-the-art facilities within the center and this means through PREDICT you will be part of a well-funded research environment equipped with the latest technologies, unique data, and a world-leading network of collaborators.

PREDICT has grown to become a world-renowned center, organized as a broad, national and interdisciplinary collaboration between Aalborg University and Aalborg University Hospital, with a multidisciplinary team of immunologists, geneticists, data scientists, clinicians and many more disciplines. PREDICT also has strong international collaborations across the world.

You can read more about PREDICT here: www.predictibd.dk

About the Department of Clinical Medicine

The Department of Clinical Medicine provides research-based teaching across all disciplines of the

medical degree programme and conducts research within the clinical specialties.

Read more about the Department of Clinical Medicine here

How to apply

Your application must contain the following:

• A brief motivated application describing your professional and personal competences and the experience qualifying you particularly for the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Examination certificate

• Any other relevant appendices

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Chief Statistician, Group Leader Gry J. Poulsen, gryjp@dcm.aau.dk

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

**

Salary and terms of employment

**Your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the Collective Agreement for Academic Staff Employed in the State Sector with the classification academic officer or special consultant. Classification is based on competence, experience and seniority, with the possibility of negotiating qualification-based supplements.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Technical and administrative positions Academic (AC-TAP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the sections entitled “Academic Officer” and “Special consultant”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us as a DevOps & Platform Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in building, operating, and continuously enhancing the platforms and services that drive product development, testing, validation, deployment, and operations within Siemens Gamesa’s digital ecosystem. Imagine developing automation solutions, enhancing CI/CD pipelines, and collaborating with software teams to elevate the developer experience and operational efficiency. You will work closely with product development, validation, architecture, and infrastructure teams to ensure that our platforms remain reliable, secure, and scalable. Whether you are modernizing platform services or contributing to cloud-enabled solutions, your efforts will significantly accelerate how engineering teams deliver innovative solutions. Become part of an international team that values ownership, innovation, and knowledge sharing in a culture driven by a strong engineering mindset.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Design, build, and operate platform services that support product development, testing, validation, and deployment activities.

• Develop automation solutions that enhance reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.

• Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code, automated deployments, CI/CD pipelines, and platform tooling.

• Develop integrations and automation using APIs, scripting, and modern DevOps practices.

• Improve observability through monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and operational analytics.

• Support and evolve virtualization and platform technologies while contributing to modernization initiatives and future cloud capabilities.

• Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product teams, and infrastructure specialists to enhance developer productivity and platform capabilities.

• Contribute to platform standardization, self-service capabilities, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What You Bring

Must Have

• Experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Software Engineering, or Infrastructure Automation.

• Strong experience with automation technologies such as Ansible, PowerShell, PowerCLI, Python, Git, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD tooling.

• Proven ability to create and maintain automation frameworks, deployment pipelines, APIs, integrations, or platform services.

• Familiarity with virtualization and platform technologies like VMware vSphere, vCenter, vSAN, ESXi, Proxmox VE, or similar enterprise platforms.

• Knowledge of Linux and/or Windows administration, scripting, troubleshooting, and system integration.

• Experience with monitoring, observability, logging, incident management, performance analysis, and service reliability practices.

• A proactive mindset with a passion for automation, continuous learning, and building reliable platform services.

Nice to Have

• Exposure to cloud-native technologies, containers, Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud platforms.

• Experience in Agile environments using Scrum or SAFe methodologies, along with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Git-based workflows.

• Familiarity with platform modernization, self-service platforms, developer experience initiatives, or Infrastructure as Code practices.

• Experience supporting engineering applications, industrial systems, SCADA environments, or operational technology solutions.

About the Team

You will join the Infrastructure Performance & Operations (IPO) team within Digital Products & Solutions. This team is dedicated to developing, operating, and evolving the digital platforms that support product engineering, validation, testing, and business operations across Siemens Gamesa. Our focus areas include platform engineering, automation, virtualization, CI/CD, observability, service reliability, infrastructure modernization, and operational excellence. We collaborate closely with product teams to simplify operations through automation, enhance developer experience, and provide scalable platform capabilities that support the development, validation, and delivery of digital products in the wind energy sector. Working in an Agile environment, we utilize Scrum and SAFe practices, ensuring alignment across development, infrastructure, architecture, validation, and product organizations. As our digital landscape evolves, the team is also shaping future platform capabilities, cloud adoption opportunities, and next-generation Digital Foundation services. We value collaboration, technical curiosity, knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and engineers who thrive on solving complex challenges through code, automation, and modern platform engineering practices.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking talented individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: Working at Siemens Energy: Careers & Job Opportunities

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

Here are examples of the rewards and benefits Siemens Energy offers:

• Opportunities to work with a global team

• Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects

• Medical benefits

• Hybrid (3x per week in the office) / Flexible work

• Time off/Paid holidays and parental leave

• Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform

• Access to a variety of employee resource groups

Help build the next generation of technology leaders. EIFO backs ambitious Danish companies with the potential to become global leaders and strengthen Denmark’s competitiveness. As AI, advanced computing and quantum technologies reshape industries, we are strengthening our Frontier Technologies team. We are looking for an experienced Investment Director who combines solid investment judgment, deep technology insight and a passion for helping founders build globally competitive businesses.

About the role

You will identify, lead and develop investments across deep tech, AI, next-generation computing and quantum technologies, including the infrastructure, hardware and software enabling future technological breakthroughs.

From sourcing and investment execution to active portfolio development, you will work closely with founders, co-investors and industry partners to turn technological potential into commercial success.

Reporting to Sara Sande, Partner & Head of Frontier Technologies, you will collaborate with colleagues across EIFO and the wider innovation ecosystem.

What you’ll do

• Invest in promising technologies

• Source and lead investments from initial assessment through due diligence, negotiation and closing.

• Develop investment theses and assess technology, markets, teams and business models.

• Structure investments alongside founders and co-investors.

• Help build and scale companies

• Manage a portfolio of technology companies.

• Support founders on strategy, financing, governance and international growth.

• Contribute through board work, strategic sparring and follow-on investments.

• Strengthen our team and ecosystem

• Help shape EIFO’s Frontier Technologies investment strategy.

• Build relationships across the international investment community, research and industry.

• Share knowledge, support teammates, and help build a collaborative team.

What you’ll bring

You combine investment experience, commercial judgment and a deep understanding of technology.

We imagine you bring several of the following:

• Experience from venture capital, corporate venture, institutional investment or a similar environment.

• A track record of sourcing, evaluating and leading technology investments.

• Experience developing portfolio companies and working closely with founders, including board experience.

• Extensive experience in deep tech, AI, next-generation computing and/or quantum technologies.

• The ability to translate complex technology into clear commercial and investment perspectives.

You are intellectually curious, methodical and comfortable making decisions in uncertain environments.

You own your work, ask questions constructively and value collaboration. You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues succeed.

We value different career paths and perspectives, alongside the skills and judgment needed to make sound investment decisions.

Why EIFO?

EIFO is Denmark’s sovereign investment fund, providing capital and risk-sharing solutions to Danish businesses, from startups to established companies expanding internationally.

At EIFO, you can invest in technologies that matter, work alongside motivated founders and help improve Denmark’s future competitiveness. You will combine investment responsibility with the opportunity to build companies and create lasting economic and societal value.

Are you our next colleague?

Desired start date is as soon as possible.

EIFO encourages candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Let’s build the future together.

About Denmark’s Export and Investment Fund

EIFO is Denmark's sovereign investment fund. We provide patient capital to startups, scaleups and growth companies while supporting Denmark's long-term competitiveness and innovation capacity.

Few investment platforms offer the combination of impact, access and long-term perspective that EIFO does. As Denmark's sovereign investment fund, we are uniquely positioned to connect research, entrepreneurship, industry and capital. This creates a rare opportunity to identify and support breakthrough technologies before they become global companies.

At EIFO, you will not only invest in companies - you will help shape the technologies, industries and capabilities that are critical to Europe's future competitiveness, resilience and prosperity.

The Frontier Technologies Team is a part of the EIFO Investment Team.

jobs.occupation: Team Leader, Evening Shift - Fruit & Vegetables Salling Group, Terminal Holme
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy bringing people together, creating structure and making things happen? Are you motivated by developing others while ensuring that daily operations run smoothly – even when things get busy? Then you might be our new Team Leader for the evening shift in Fruit & Vegetables at Terminal Holme.

At Salling Group, we believe that good leadership is not just about having a title. It is about taking responsibility, setting clear expectations and helping others succeed.

We are looking for a leader who understands that strong performance and employee well-being go hand in hand.

**Your role – leading people and delivering results

**As Team Leader, you will be responsible for the daily operations of our evening shift, working closely with the Department Manager and your fellow leaders.Our evening shift operates from 12:00 to 20:00, and you will play a key role in ensuring that our colleagues have the right conditions to succeed and that our stores receive their deliveries on time.Your main responsibilities will include:

• Lead and develop your team: Create direction, communicate expectations, provide feedback and support the development of colleagues and future leaders.

• Ensure strong daily operations: Plan staffing and resources, coordinate priorities and maintain an efficient operation with a high level of delivery accuracy.

• Drive continuous improvement: Challenge existing routines, involve colleagues in finding better solutions and use KPIs and LEAN principles to improve performance.

• Take ownership of safety and well-being: Create a working environment where everyone is treated with respect, safety comes first and challenges are addressed rather than ignored.

• Follow up and take action: Conduct daily team meetings, follow up on productivity, absence and performance, and ensure that decisions turn into action.

You will report to the Department Manager and become part of the Team Leader group at Terminal Holme.

Who are you?

We are looking for someone who wants to make a difference – both for the business and for the people they lead.

You are comfortable making decisions, including the difficult ones, and you understand that being a good leader sometimes means having honest conversations.

We imagine that you:

• Have experience from warehouse operations, logistics or a similar operational environment.

• Have leadership experience or have demonstrated a strong ability to lead and develop others.

• Communicate clearly and confidently in both English and Danish.

• Are structured, solution-oriented and able to maintain an overview when priorities change.

• Take responsibility, follow through on commitments and lead by example.

Most importantly, you are genuinely interested in people. You listen, involve your colleagues and are willing to challenge them when needed.

We do not expect you to have all the answers. We do expect you to take ownership, be curious and have the courage to act.

What can you expect from us?

At Terminal Holme, we supply fresh fruit and vegetables to Bilka and føtex stores across Jutland and Funen.

You will join an international working environment with colleagues from many different backgrounds, where English is a natural part of everyday communication. Our operations run around the clock, and strong collaboration across shifts is essential.

You will become part of a leadership team that values open dialogue, accountability and continuous development.

Our leadership culture is built around a Culture of Care – where we care about our colleagues, challenge each other constructively and never compromise on safety or respect.

You will have the opportunity to influence how we work, develop your own leadership skills and contribute to building an even stronger team.

As part of Salling Group, you will also have access to our employee benefits programme, offering a range of attractive discounts and benefits across Salling Group's stores and businesses.

Agile Delivery Manager – Turn Priorities Into Progress at RiskPoint

On behalf of RiskPoint, we are looking for a structured and hands-on Agile Delivery Manager to join their growing IT-team. If you thrive on bringing people together, creating clarity across complex deliveries, and helping teams turn priorities into reliable outcomes, this could be your next career opportunity.

About RiskPoint:

RiskPoint Group is a fast-growing global Managing General Underwriter (MGU), providing best-in-class insurance solutions backed by the insurance companies they represent.

As an Agile Delivery Manager at RiskPoint, you will become part of a growing IT-organisation, working closely with colleagues across technology and the business. You will play a key role in driving delivery across teams, functions, and external partners, both in Denmark and the rest of the world.

RiskPoint operates in an agile and collaborative environment, with strong cross-border cooperation across all business lines. With a flat organisational structure and a culture built on trust and responsibility, RiskPoint offers employees the opportunity to make a real impact, take ownership, and grow both personally and professionally.

About the Position:

As an Agile Delivery Manager at RiskPoint, you will play a central role in turning priorities into structured and predictable delivery. You will be responsible for coordinating work across teams and stakeholders, establishing a clear delivery rhythm, and ensuring that dependencies, risks, and decisions are identified and addressed at the right time.

This position goes beyond traditional project management. You will support agile ways of working, helping teams plan, prioritise, and deliver effectively, while respecting the responsibilities of Product Owners and the teams' ownership of their day-to-day activities.

The position is based onsite at RiskPoint's Copenhagen office, with occasional domestic and international travel.

You will report to Programme Manager, Christoffer Marcus Tøttrup, who is based in Copenhagen.

Your key responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

• 
Drive day-to-day delivery coordination across multiple teams, stakeholders, and external partners

• 
Turn agreed priorities and outcomes into clear, realistic, and well-sequenced delivery plans

• 
Facilitate planning sessions, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, and other relevant delivery meetings

• 
Create and maintain a transparent delivery rhythm with clear milestones, commitments, and follow-up

• 
Identify and coordinate cross-team dependencies and help resolve blockers before they affect delivery

• 
Maintain clear visibility of progress, risks, issues, decisions, and required escalations

• 
Coordinate release and implementation activities, including readiness, testing, approvals, communication, and handover

• 
Help teams apply practical agile methods suited to the work, rather than following a fixed framework for its own sake

• 
Support continuous improvement of delivery practices, governance, collaboration, and ways of working

• 
Provide clear and concise status updates to stakeholders and management

• 
Help build a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, cooperation, and reliable follow-through

Please note that applicants must currently reside in Denmark and hold a valid work and residence permit. Fluency in both written and spoken Danish and English is required.

Your Profile – A great Match for RiskPoint:

For this position, we are looking for a structured, proactive, and collaborative Agile Delivery Manager who thrives on creating clarity, driving progress, and bringing people together across teams and functions.

You have a relevant educational background in business, technology, project management, or a related field. However, your practical experience and ability to turn priorities into tangible results are more important than your formal qualifications.

We expect you to have a minimum of 4–5 years of professional experience in agile delivery, project delivery, Scrum Master roles, delivery coordination, or a similar position. You have a proven track record of supporting teams and stakeholders in translating priorities into structured execution and measurable outcomes.

To succeed in this role, you should bring:

• 
Hands-on experience with agile ways of working and the ability to adapt them to different teams and types of work

• 
Experience planning and coordinating delivery across several stakeholders, teams, or external partners

• 
The ability to identify dependencies, risks, blockers, and decisions and ensure they are followed through

• 
Experience facilitating meetings and creating clear actions, ownership, and next steps

• 
Strong stakeholder communication skills and the ability to make complex delivery topics easy to understand

• 
A structured approach to planning, documentation, status reporting, and follow-up

• 
The confidence to challenge unclear priorities, unrealistic commitments, and missing ownership in a constructive way

• 
Experience using common planning and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms

It-is furthermore a requirement that you have a proven track record of working effectively in team settings, communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and building trusted relationships across organisational boundaries.

To be successful in this role, they expect you to take ownership, create structure without unnecessary process, communicate clearly, and stay focused on progress and outcomes. You should be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change and where good delivery depends on close collaboration.

Although not required, RiskPoint would prefer candidates who have:

• 
Experience with software delivery, testing, release, and implementation processes

• 
Experience working with distributed or cross-border teams

• 
Certified in Scrum, agile delivery, or project management

jobs.occupation: Professor in Mathematical Finance and Statistics
jobs.description:
Aalborg University is seeking an outstanding Professor in Mathematical Finance and Statistics to lead the newly established Research Center for Energy Mathematics, a strategic collaboration with Centrica Energy.

As the Centrica Energy Chair, you will work at the interface of academic research and challenges in energy markets, quantitative analytics, data science, and algorithmic decision-making.

Your work tasks

This is primarily a research and research-leadership position. You will conduct international leading research in energy mathematics, develop a long-term research agenda, publish in top-journals, attract external funding, and strengthen Aalborg University's position in the field.

As Director of the Research Center for Energy Mathematics, you will build and lead a research community of PhD students, postdoctoral researchers, visiting scholars and international collaborators. Collaboration with Centrica Energy will provide opportunities to engage in real-world challenges while preserving academic freedom and the highest scientific standards. You will supervise PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and master’s students. Teaching and administrative responsibilities are expected to be limited and organized to support the position’s focus on research and research leadership.

The aim is to establish a globally recognized center that advances fundamental and applied research in energy mathematics and contributes to academia, society, and the green energy transition

**Who we are looking for

**

We seek a researcher with a strong academic track record and the ambition to shape the emerging field of energy mathematics. Relevant expertise may include stochastic optimization, stochastic analysis, uncertainty quantification, mathematical modelling, machine learning, causal inference, computational mathematics, or related disciplines.

We welcome candidates with mathematical depth and broad intellectual curiosity, especially researchers who address fundamental questions about complex and uncertain energy systems and markets across traditional disciplinary boundaries. Applicants must demonstrate research experience at the highest international level through an outstanding publication record, doctoral supervision, competitive research funding and international collaboration.

In addition to scientific excellence, we are looking for a colleague who is enthusiastic about building and leading a collaborative research environment and with an openness to dialogue with industry.

Qualification requirements

Applicants must be able to document a high degree of original academic production at an international level and experience from teaching at different levels. Including tests/exams, course/study programme management as well as contributions to the development of teaching activities and teaching material.

Emphasis is placed on the extent, to which the applicant, has developed the academic discipline from a research and teaching perspective.

Emphasis may moreover be placed on the applicant’s ability to carry out and develop research-based public-sector consultancy. Also, emphasis will be placed on an assessment of the applicant’s ability to perform research and teaching management tasks and possibly fulfil other functions, for example in relation to the university’s external cooperation.

Emphasis will also be placed on the applicant's ability to undertake pedagogical supervision, supervision and academic assessment work.

Additional q ualification requirements

Applicants must hold a Ph.D. in mathematics or in a closely related discipline and have a sustained record of original and influential research.

Emphasis will be placed on the ability to formulate and pursue ambitious research agendas and to establish and lead an internationally recognized research environment. Experience with competitive research funding, international collaboration, and mentoring doctoral and postdoctoral researchers is important.

Applicants must preferably document university teaching and supervision experience at the undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral level.

Leadership experience with research teams, centers, or large collaborative projects is a strong plus. The ability to foster interdisciplinary collaboration and engage with partners in academia, industry, and the public sector is also valued.

The assessment will consider scientific achievements, academic leadership, educational contributions, supervision experience, international standing, and the potential to strengthen Aalborg University's research and education in energy mathematics.

Who we are

The position is anchored at the Department of Mathematical Sciences at Aalborg University, one of Scandinavia's leading environments for applied mathematics, stochastic modelling, and data-driven research. The department offers an international and collaborative research environment with strong links to academia, industry, and society.

The Research Center for Energy Mathematics is established through a strategic collaboration between Aalborg University and Centrica Energy, a leading European energy trading and energy management company active in power, gas, renewable energy, algorithmic trading, analytics, and quantitative research. While the professorship is an independent academic position at Aalborg University, the collaboration with Centrica Energy provides exceptional opportunities for research inspiration, access to relevant data and problems, and interaction with leading practitioners in quantitative energy trading and analytics.

Together, Aalborg University and Centrica Energy aim to create a globally recognized center in energy mathematics that attracts outstanding researchers and students from around the world.

How to apply

Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma)

• List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of ten publications.

• Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design, The Faculty of Engineering and Science and The Faculty of Medicine. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .

• Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc.

• Additional qualifications in relation to the position

• References/recommendations

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions?

If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information

Read more about our recruitment process here

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Salary and terms of employment

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Professor”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
